overclaims: Specified harmful requests were routed to Opus 4.8, while Mythos 5 without those limits remained restricted to vetted customers [e1].

The Opus 4.8 routing is supported. But the saved source text stops at 'Anthropic is able t' and never says Mythos 5 is the same model or is limited to vetted customers. Only the drafter's explanation says that. Axis, horizon, outcome, quote and proposition are fine.
